name: Coq au Vin
body:
Station and Complexity entremetier 6

Flavor Profiles umami, sweet, umami, salty, temperature, sweet
Additional Ingredients bitter, sweet, or texture

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 1d8

DESCRIPTION

Chicken braised with wine, lardons, mushrooms, and sometimes garlic; all of which is bathed in a red wine thickened with a roux or blood.

When consumed, it allows the creature to ignore an amount of energy resistance equal to the culinarian’s level for the duration. If the creature threatens a critical hit within the duration and deals bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, it deals additional damage of the same type equal to half the culinarian’s level, even if it doesn’t confirm the critical hit.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size and duration by +1.
